articles.title: Franchisee reconciles cash in 94% less time with ChatGPT Work
articles.summary: An independent Schlotzsky’s and Cinnabon franchisee cut menu repricing time by 95% and built a workflow that could free up $100K in cash flow.

articles.title: Using Claude to reduce the attack surface of code
articles.summary: Automated attack surface analysis and reduction can meaningfully improve the security of deployed software in the near term. In this post, we preview data we’ve collected from applying attack surface reduction techniques to large open-source codebases using Claude.

articles.title: How Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins
articles.summary: We asked an internal research Claude model to design minibinders (small proteins that attach tightly to a target) against scorpion neurotoxins.

articles.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
articles.summary: OpenAI is acquiring Orchestra Bio to bring AI-powered operations to life sciences R&D, helping biopharma teams accelerate drug development and advance new treatments.

articles.title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
articles.summary: Learn how OpenAI is improving ChatGPT across low-resource programming languages, with new evaluations for software engineering, SQLite, and COBOL migration.

articles.title: Investing in the public benefit
articles.summary: We’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows.
